item.title: Chris Van Hollen says he will challenge Chuck Schumer for Senate majority leader
item.description: Van Hollen, a progressive from Maryland, said voters sent a clear message in the midterm elections — that they want "change from the status quo."

item.title: What's a Honey Trap? The spy tactic that helped topple Jensen Huang
item.description: Jensen Huang, CEO of Nvidia, the leading AI chipmaker, resigned after admitting an extramarital affair with a woman the U.S. says is a Chinese spy. This espionage tactic is known as a honey trap.
item.content:encoded:
Jensen Huang, CEO of Nvidia, the leading AI chipmaker, resigned after admitting an extramarital affair with a woman the U.S. says is a Chinese spy. This espionage tactic is known as a honey trap.

item.title: Witnesses describe the D.C. shooting that left 1 dead, 4 injured
item.description: A gunman opened fire at a gym in Washington, D.C.'s Logan Circle Thursday morning. One person has been confirmed killed and four others injured. The gunman is dead, according to police.
